responsibility: Lists the MVE predicate and vector ACLE types in a compact macro-driven form used to generate type metadata. Each entry names an ACLE type, its associated scalar tree node, and whether floating-point support is required, allowing the MVE type-registration code to build scalar, ABI-vector, and frontend-exposed type tables consistently.
same_name_distinction: Is the macro data table that enumerates MVE predicate/vector ACLE types and whether they require floating point; unlike arm-mve-builtins.cc it has no registration logic, and unlike arm-mve-builtins.h it is not the exported declaration interface.
